description.narrative: The Strategy is expected to pioneer commercially viable models for carbon-sequestration through conservation and restoration of degraded land in LAC. Beyond the project, the Strategys success will demonstrate that private equity (PE) can deliver financial returns while implementing large-scale carbon removal through Nature-based Solutions (NbS). This will in turn de-risk the market for future entrants and encourage other large managers to launch dedicated NbS funds in Emerging Markets.

The proposed IFC investment involves an equity investment of up to US$53 million in The Reforestation Strategy (the Strategy), which will be managed by BTG Timberland Investment Group (TIG). This investment will allow IFC to get equity exposure to all the assets of the Strategy and would support the acquisition of land, the establishment of FSC-certified commercial tree farms, and restoration efforts to preserve and enhance biodiversity, primarily in Brazil, Chile and Uruguay (the Project). The financing is expected to enable the protection and restoration of 135,000 hectares of natural forest, the planting of 200 million trees on 135,000 hectares of degraded land, and the generation of more than 36 million forest carbon offsets over 15 years. The Strategy targets raising up to US$1 billion in equity.
